text:
sana (partnerships): Quick sync — CloudCo marketplace IaC onboarding. Need a short smoke-test plan and a minimal Terraform example we can use in the partner portal. Can we ship a draft by EOD?

diego (cloud-eng): I can put together the smoke-test. Idea: deploy the module to a tiny cluster, run a basic healthcheck endpoint, run a tiny inference request, then destroy. Keeps cost low.

elaine (solutions): Do we have a canonical starter module to extend, or should I scaffold a new module under infra/marketplace-starters?

kevin (infra): I recommend a single module with three example workspaces: aws, gcp, oci. And a variables matrix for arch: arm64/amd64. Keeps CI coverage manageable.

alex (pm): +1 to matrix. Also include marketplace metadata manifest and a license field so listing automation can consume it.

marketplace-bot: Deployment preview queued: build/2954 — will post logs when ready.

diego (cloud-eng): Here's a tiny example we can use in docs for partners (put into examples/simple_deploy/main.tf):

```terraform
module "marketplace_quickstart" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac.git//modules/quickstart"
  cloud  = var.cloud
  region = var.region
  image  = var.image
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}

output "endpoint" {
  value = module.marketplace_quickstart.public_endpoint
}
```

kevin (infra): For the smoke check CI job: run plan -> apply (tiny size) -> curl $endpoint/health -> run one inference curl -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' $endpoint/infer -> assert latency < 200ms -> terraform destroy. We can gate on a single GPU SKU for the test.

elaine (solutions): I'll add a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/marketplace-smoke.yml that runs the matrix (aws/gcp/oci x arm64/amd64) but keep concurrency low. Will stub credentials with secrets and document what partners need to provide.

alex (pm): Can partnerships own the publish checklist (manifest, screenshots, pricing metadata, security checklist)? Sana, can you take point and loop in security/docs?

sana (partnerships): Yep, I'll own the checklist and will ping docs + security. Also want an approval step: partner QA -> Redwood infra review -> marketplace publish.

kevin (infra): Small ask: include an optional flag to skip building model artifacts when partners provide prebuilt container images. Saves CI time.

elaine (solutions): Good call. I'll add `skip_image_build` boolean var and example in README.

sana (partnerships): Thanks team. Next actions: Diego drafts smoke test and example module by 3pm PST, Elaine wires CI + README, Kevin adds arch matrix and skip flag, Alex will draft the partner-facing publish checklist. I'll coordinate the first partner dry-run next week. :thumbsup:
